description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named ReviewKpiSearchFilterParams used within the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It extends the FilterParams class and provides properties and methods related to search filter parameters for review KPIs, including review ID and reviewer group name.

classes.name: ReviewKpiSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO for specifying search filters related to review KPIs, including review ID and reviewer group name, with default sorting on KPI title.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params with default sort field set to 'kpi.title'.

methods.name: getReviewId
methods.description: Returns the review ID associated with the filter parameters.

methods.name: setReviewId
methods.description: Sets the review ID for the filter parameters.

methods.name: getReviewerGroupName
methods.description: Returns the name of the reviewer group.

methods.name: setReviewerGroupName
methods.description: Sets the name of the reviewer group.
